mapper.update: UPDATE budget_account SET reserved_amount = reserved_amount + #{amount}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND currency = #{currency} AND reserved_amount + settled_amount + #{amount} <= total_limit
mapper.select: INSERT INTO budget_reservation (tenant_id, account_id, run_id, operation_id, reserved_amount, state) SELECT tenant_id, account_id, #{runId}::uuid, #{operationId}::uuid, #{amount}, 'RESERVED' FROM budget_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND currency = #{currency} ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, operation_id) WHERE operation_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING RETURNING reservation_id::text

INSERT INTO usage_record (tenant_id, run_id, operation_id, reservation_id, model_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_amount, currency) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{runId}::uuid, #{operationId}::uuid, #{reservationId}::uuid, #{modelId}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{costAmount}, #{currency}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, operation_id) WHERE operation_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING RETURNING usage_id::text

SELECT r.reservation_id::text AS reservationId, r.run_id::text AS runId, r.operation_id::text AS operationId, r.reserved_amount AS reservedAmount, r.settled_amount AS settledAmount, r.state AS state, (SELECT currency FROM budget_account a WHERE a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND a.account_id = r.account_id) AS currency, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM budget_reservation r JOIN tool_operation o ON o.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND o.operation_id = r.operation_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND r.state = 'RESERVED' AND o.state IN #{s} ORDER BY r.created_at

SELECT account_id::text AS accountId, currency, total_limit AS totalLimit, reserved_amount AS reservedAmount, settled_amount AS settledAmount FROM budget_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND currency = #{currency}

SELECT (SELECT reserved_amount FROM budget_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND currency = #{currency}) AS acctReserved, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reserved_amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM budget_reservation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND state = 'RESERVED') AS detailReserved, (SELECT settled_amount FROM budget_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND currency = #{currency}) AS acctSettled, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(settled_amount), 0) FROM budget_reservation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND state = 'SETTLED') AS detailSettled
